name: ANGRAMM
description: ANGRAMM is a creative agency and audiovisual production company in Marseille: films for Olympique de Marseille, Lacoste, Mizuno, adidas, Kappa, Umbro and Crocs.
intro: ANGRAMM is a creative agency and audiovisual production company. Driven by major collaborations with high-profile partners, we bring our creative and technical expertise to any industry, both in France and internationally.
ANGRAMM was born in Marseille. We imagine, shoot and finish films for brands, clubs and artists, from street documentary to full CGI.
We work as one crew, from the first idea to the final grade, with the same obsession: images that feel true to the places and the people they come from.

values.title: Territory
values.text: Every project starts from a place and the people who live there: Marseille, Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Nanterre.

values.title: Craft
values.text: Creative and technical expertise under one roof, from concept and direction to CGI and post-production.

values.title: Partnership
values.text: Major collaborations with high-profile partners, built on trust and on work that lasts.
